title: showerhead-equiv: 3D-to-2D equivalence of multi-hole showerhead rings

creators.name: Yoon, Jung Hwan
creators.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Dong-A University, Busan, Republic of Korea

description: Python package and web calculator accompanying the article 'A 3D-to-2D modelling framework of multi-hole showerheads for process screening of remote plasma reactors' (J. H. Yoon and J.-H. Lee, submitted to Nature Chemical Engineering). For each concentric ring of N identical cylindrical holes it returns the axisymmetric representation used in the article: the annular slot half-width that preserves the laminar flow conductance of the ring at a given pressure drop (Eq. 3) and the effective wall reaction probability gamma_eff = gamma N r / (2L) that preserves the wall loss of radicals on the hole side walls (Eq. 4). Standard library only; includes a command-line batch tool, a synthetic example with reference outputs and tests. The proprietary hole layouts of the reactors studied in the article are not included.
